wiki.summary: Drake teased the instrumental and introduction of “National Treasure” in the outro of Episode 2 of his ICEMAN livestream series on YouTube. The song was played in full on a Pump Fun stream promoting a memecoin BAGWORK. Days later DJ Akademiks played the song on his stream, confirming its title, “National Treasure.” He also shared that the song is at least a year old and parts, if not a full music video was shot. According to Akademiks, the song, “No Face,” and its accompanying music video were released instead. Read more on Last.fm.
